plan.title: Forward auction auto-title for mixed-family products

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow reached from Create Event > Single Stage.
Set the event type to Auction before selecting the auction template.
Select the forward/sell auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the first product from family F1.
Set the first product's location and allow the automatic title to populate.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Capture the automatically generated title before adding the second product.
Add the second product from the different family F2.
Set the second product to the same location used by the first product.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Forward Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB & more - Plant Name

steps.note: Assert the mixed-family auto-title uses the first product, '& more', and the shared location.
Remove the second product while the title remains automatically managed.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Assert that removing the second product restores the earlier single-product auto-title.
